items.title: TRANSITORY LIFE
items.quote: Incline your ear all who dwell in this transitory world.
items.text: Remember that this world is transitory and whatever material things you build up here have no permanence.

items.w: למה אירא בימי רע עון עקבי יסובני
items.quote: Why should I [devote myself to material wealth because I] fear bad times? The sin [following] on my heels will surround me.
items.text: Your true protection is Hashem. The only thing you really have to fear is sin.

items.title: TIME FOR TESHUVAH
items.quote: The redemption of their soul [for money] is unattainable. [After death, repentance] is ended forever.
items.text: Do teshuvah (repentance) for your sins now because you will not be able to do so after you die.

items.w: אך אלהים יפדה נפשי מיד שאול כי יקחני סלה
items.title: BEYOND THE GRAVE
items.quote: But, may G-d redeem my soul from the power of the grave. May He take me [to Him for eternal life], Selah!
items.text: Ask that your teshuvah will be accepted and you will have life beyond the grave.

items.w: אדם ביקר ולא יבין נמשל כבהמות נדמו
items.quote: Even with [wealth and] honor, [if] a man does not understand, he is comparable to the animals that fall silent.
